summary: Liberty Defense Holdings filed a Form 6-K on September 24, 2026, disclosing a non-exclusive U.S. distribution agreement with VMI Security for its HEXWAVE walkthrough screening system, plus routine equity grants. The company, listed on NASDAQ (DETX) and TSXV (SCAN), announced 43,888 restricted share units to directors and officers: 23,888 vesting September 24, 2027, and 20,000 vesting September 24, 2028, all expiring September 24, 2031. No financial terms, pricing, advisors, or board recommendations were disclosed. This is an ordinary commercial contract and compensation matter, not a special situation; watch for commercial traction.
